about: How a step's easyRead text is split into one point per action. The caregiver's editor (apps/caregiver/src/planner/format.ts) and the traveller app (apps/traveller/src/lib/easyRead.ts) must give the same points, so the traveller reads exactly what the caregiver checked. Both apps' tests run every case here; add a case here, not in one app.
